messages:
sophia: Quick note from Orchid-lite q6 bringup: small but clear regression on mixed CJK+RTL lines where NBSP/ZWJ boundaries exist. Outputs glue characters and invert bracket orientation.
rahul: can you drop the minimal example and the metric deltas?
sophia: sure. Summary: fp16 BLEU=30.7 / chrF=0.605 -> q6 BLEU=29.0 / chrF=0.587 on our mixed-locale slice (~2.5 delta BLEU). Mostly NBSP (0xA0) and ZWJ cases.
mei: paste repro pls
sophia: Minimal repro (NBSP shown as \u00A0):
```
INPUT: "\u5e02\u6c11\u00A0\u0627\u0644\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645\uff0c\u8acb\u554f\u4eca\u5929\u597d\uff1f"
FP16_OUT: "\u5e02\u6c11 \u0627\u0644\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645\u3002 \u8acb\u554f\u4eca\u5929\u597d\uff1f"
Q6_OUT: "\u5e02\u6c11\u0627\u0644\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645)\u3002\u8acb\u554f\u4eca\u5929?"
```
rahul: interesting — tokenizer wasn't modified for Orchid-lite. Could be an id remap step in the quant exporter or the runtime.
eval-bot: Running quick slice: mixed-subtitles-nbsp-zwj (n=1,842). Results: fp16 BLEU 30.7 -> q6 BLEU 29.0 (delta -1.7). chrF 0.605 -> 0.587 (delta -0.018). Concentration: 172 samples with NBSP at CJK-RTL boundary. Top suspect token ids after remap: [4412,4413] show collision.
infra-bot: Exporter run id 9912 produced q6 artifacts; mapping table at s3://redwood-inference-exports/orchid-lite/q6/mapping-9912.json
mei: immediate mitigation: pin current onboard to fp16 in canary and add a regression smoke that includes NBSP/ZWJ combos.
rahul: agreed. I'll open ML ticket ML-1310 to track mapping fix and QA-4480 for the smoke. 
sophia: thanks — tagging @mei for canary hold. We'll follow up once the remap table is validated.
